review_candidates.description: Terracotta is currently recruiting an experienced Business Planning & Budgeting Manager on behalf of a leading organization within the UAE's Utilities sector. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in group-level financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and portfolio performance management across a diverse portfolio of energy assets. The successful candidate will work closely with senior finance leadership and operating companies, providing financial insights, challenging performance assumptions, and supporting strategic investment and capital planning decisions. Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE Key Responsibilities: 1. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting Lead annual budgeting, business planning, and forecasting activities across multiple entities and assets. Review actual financial performance against budgets, forecasts, and business plans, identifying key variances and areas requiring corrective action. Analyse revenue, costs, profitability, and cash flow to assess financial performance and support business planning. Challenge financial assumptions and forecasting methodologies to improve accuracy and reliability. Support the development of financial plans aligned with business objectives and long-term strategic priorities. 2. Group Consolidation & Financial Reporting Review and oversee group-level financial consolidation across multiple operating companies, entities, and assets. Ensure appropriate intercompany reconciliations and eliminations are reflected in consolidated financial reporting. Review and analyse financial statements, including profit and loss (P&L) and cash flow, to assess overall financial performance. Validate financial information submitted by operating companies, challenging inconsistencies and investigating significant variances. Ensure financial reporting aligns with applicable IFRS requirements and internal reporting standards. Prepare consolidated financial analysis and management reports to support senior leadership decision-making. 3. Portfolio & Asset Performance Management Review monthly financial performance reports submitted by operating companies across a diverse portfolio of energy assets. Monitor and evaluate financial performance across multiple assets, entities, and investments. Participate in performance review meetings, challenging reported figures and assessing performance against budgets, forecasts, and approved business plans. Identify financial risks, underperformance, cost overruns, and opportunities to improve operational and financial results. Analyse trends across the portfolio and provide recommendations to improve financial performance and accountability. Work closely with operating companies and internal stakeholders to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and transparency of financial information. 4. Investment Analysis & Capital Planning Review investment cases and assess financial feasibility, projected returns, and underlying financial assumptions. Monitor actual investment performance against approved business cases and original financial projections. Support capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning, investment assessments, and long-term financial planning. Analyse capital requirements, investment performance, and potential financial risks across the portfolio. Provide financial insights to support investment decisions, capital allocation, and strategic planning. 5. Stakeholder Management & Financial Governance Work closely with senior finance leadership, operating companies, and relevant business stakeholders to review and challenge financial performance. Present financial analysis, performance trends, and key findings to senior management. Strengthen financial planning, consolidation, forecasting, and reporting processes across the organisation. Ensure consistent financial methodologies, reliable reporting, and effective financial governance across the portfolio. Identify opportunities to improve financial controls, forecasting accuracy, and management reporting. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline. Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), business planning, budgeting, forecasting, or group finance. Strong hands-on experience in group financial consolidation and intercompany eliminations . Excellent understanding of IFRS, consolidated financial statements, P&L, and cash flow . Proven experience analysing financial performance across multiple entities, assets, investments, or operating companies. Experience in investment analysis, financial modelling, feasibility assessments, and CAPEX planning. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial modelling skills. Ability to validate and challenge financial information, investigate variances, and communicate findings to senior stakeholders. Experience in industry-side finance functions is highly preferred. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills. Preferred Industry Experience We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in: Power Generation Energy & Utilities Renewable Energy Infrastructure Independent Power Producers Investment Holding Companies Portfolio and Asset-Based Businesses Diversified Groups with Multiple Operating Companies Candidates with a strong combination of FP&A, group consolidation, and portfolio financial performance analysis are particularly encouraged to apply.

review_candidates.title: Assistant / Associate Professor in International Relations of the Middle East
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy In today’s rapidly evolving global environment, where national security and prosperity increasingly depend on informed and well-connected leaders and policy makers, the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy (AGDA) is a leading centre of excellence that educates the next generations of foreign policy decision makers and informs the public on the most pressing challenges facing the region and the world. Job Objective: The Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy (AGDA) is seeking to hire three faculty members at the Assistant and Associate Professor levels to teach in its new Master of Arts in International Relations of the Middle East. The program is a 30-credit, 12-month MA combining core courses in international relations theory, regional history, political economy, foreign policy and security with electives and a client-based policy capstone. Faculty members are anticipated to teach core and elective courses, supervise capstone projects, evaluate student work, publish high-impact research in academic journals, convene initiatives and events, engage in administrative and committee tasks as required, contribute to professional service in their discipline, and participate in AGDA’s campus life as required.   Key Responsibilities/Duties: Teaching: Faculty members must deliver research-driven and practice-oriented teaching within AGDA’s Master’s program in International Relations of the Middle East and may be asked to deliver other courses across AGDA’s other academic programs. They are expected to employ the latest pedagogical techniques that encourage student inquiry, encompass a comprehensive body of knowledge, and develop essential skills and competencies, including the policy writing and briefing skills that ministries and embassies require. Areas of Specialization: AGDA is recruiting for three complementary profiles. Applicants should indicate in their cover letter which position(s) they are applying for. Position 1 – International Relations Theory and the Regional Order: The successful candidate will hold a PhD in International Relations or Political Science (with an IR specialization), or in Middle East History with a strong grounding in IR theory, and will have research expertise in the international relations of the Middle East, the formation of the regional state system and the historiography of the modern Middle East. Ability to contribute to electives such as Great Powers in the Middle East or Middle Powers Diplomacy in the Middle East is an advantage. Position 2 – Political Economy and Research Methods: The successful candidate will hold a PhD in Political Science (comparative or international political economy), Economics, or a closely related field, and will have research expertise in the political economy of the Gulf and the wider MENA region, including rentier economies, economic diversification and international economic relations. Demonstrated training in qualitative and quantitative research methods and policy analysis is required. Ability to contribute to electives such as Energy Economics in the MENAor Energy, Climate and Water Diplomacy is an advantage. Position 3 – Foreign Policy and Regional Security: The successful candidate will hold a PhD in International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies or Conflict Studies, and will have research expertise in foreign policy analysis of Middle Eastern and Gulf states and in regional security, conflict and conflict management. Ability to contribute to electives such as The Middle East Peace Process, International Law, Humanitarian Action and Mediation, or Negotiation and Diplomatic Practice is an advantage. Capstone supervision: Faculty members are expected to provide academic advising and guidance to students and to supervise client-based capstone policy projects, working with partner institutions to ensure that student work meets professional standards. Assessment & Evaluation of Students: Faculty members are required to design course assessments that are rigorous in nature and aligned with AGDA standards. They must evaluate student performance, ensuring clear assessment criteria that align with course content and learning outcomes while avoiding cognitive bias. Research & Scholarship: Faculty members must actively participate in scholarly endeavors, publishing peer- reviewed articles within their respective domains and contributing to AGDA’s research strategy and mission.  Service & Shared Governance: AGDA fosters a culture of collaborative leadership, promoting active engagement from all faculty members in meetings, committees, and decision-making groups. Elected faculty representatives must play a direct role in decision-making processes related to assessments, curriculum, research, discipline, and other committees, as needed.   Education, Qualification and Experience:   Discipline: All candidates must hold a PhD in International Relations, Political Science, or a field closely related to the position applied for, as set out under Areas of Specialization (Middle East History for Position 1; Economics or Political Economy for Position 2; Security or Conflict Studies for Position 3). A research and teaching focus on the Middle East and/or the Gulf is required. For Associate Professor: Candidates at the Associate Professor level should hold a Doctorate in their respective discipline. review_candidates.title: Technical Compliance Officer
review_candidates.description: We’re Red Tiger , a dynamic and self-contained team within the vast Evolution ecosystem, thriving with 200 talented professionals based in Sofia. Our expertise spans from product inception to final development, covering product, art, development, and more. Proudly 100% made in Bulgaria, we take immense pride in our achievements, adaptability, and the high quality of our games. Job Description As a Technical Compliance Officer, you’ll take our games from certification-ready to live in regulated markets. In practice, this is a technical project management role with domain expertise in Compliance. You’ll be given certification projects and see them through from start to finish. Day to day, that means staying proactive, keeping stakeholders aligned on deadlines, and dealing directly with test labs and regulators. You’ll push back when a lab’s finding or timeline doesn’t hold up, and you’ll handle the admin that keeps everything on record. Deadlines are agreed with you upfront and set to be realistic, and help is always on hand if something gets tricky. What you'll do: Own certification projects end to end, from lab submission through to approval and go-live, in both established and new markets. Plan your workload and timelines, track milestones and dependencies, and raise a flag early when something starts to slip. Act as the main link between our technical and creative teams and external test labs and regulators. Coordinate issues raised during testing with product, and challenge lab findings or delays when they don’t stand up. Handle post-certification activities, including regulatory submissions and any follow-up actions. Keep on top of the admin: certification records, submission paperwork, status reports and our library of post-certification activities. Qualifications Who we're looking for: Able to work on your own. We give you a project and you'll get it over the line, raising concerns where needed without being chased. Strong time management: you can juggle several projects at once and prioritise accordingly. Attention to detail and comfort with admin. This is compliance, so a wrong version number or a missed requirement matters, and keeping records straight is an essential of the job. Able to talk to different people, from technical and commercial teams to test labs and regulators, and confident enough to argue a point with a lab when a finding or timeline doesn't make sense. You communicate effectively in English (B2+) and grasp new concepts quickly. You have experience with Jira or a similar tracking tool, solid spreadsheet skills and are comfortable communicating effectively over email. Disclaimer* We don't expect the full package. If you're strong on the basics above, the domain knowledge will come quickly. You just need to be willing to learn and put the effort in. Important, but not essential: 2+ years in compliance, technical project management, delivery, or a similar role, ideally in iGaming or another regulated tech environment. An understanding of iGaming products, especially slots. Some understanding of how software gets built and tested. Who You Can Become Every step comes with training and support in advance. Growing you into that role is the long-term goal, not something we expect on day one. We're very focused on AI and automation to get better at our key activities, and you'll be part of shaping how we do that. Over time, you could end up having a say in decisions on new features, rollout plans and how we approach new markets, and negotiating commercial terms with external vendors. Additional Information What we offer: A mix of the benefits of a large company and the advantages of a creative startup culture. Company-funded training. Flexible working hours. Social benefits: a Multisport/Coolfit card and additional medical insurance. A modern office in Serdika Center with massage chairs.
